sources.snippet: For Subtask 3, two-stage QLoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-4B on emrQA-MedSQuAD and 20 annotated development cases achieves an overall score of 32.87 on the test-2026 split.

sources.title: qwen3-4b-medical-reasoning-qlora API & Inference Endpoint - FriendliAI
sources.snippet: Model Summary A LoRA adapter that fine-tunes Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on medical chain-of-thought reasoning. It is the supervised-fine-tuned ("after") checkpoint from a controlled calibration study of small medical LLMs.
